items.a: Yes. Visiting yachts up to 18 metres reserving the evening Sunset Hearth seating receive complimentary stern-to mooring until 11:00 the following morning when hailed ahead on VHF Channel 72.
items.q: Can visiting yachts book dinner and moor overnight?

items.a: Our traditional Sifnos chickpea and rosemary skepastaria pots are sealed with sourdough lute at 22:00 the night before and baked twelve hours in residual wood ash. Please note your request by 18:00 the prior evening.
items.q: When should we pre-order Sunday clay-pot revithada?

items.q: Do you accommodate celiac, pescatarian, and plant-based guests?
